### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book appropriate for different ages?**
The book is designed to introduce complex subjects in an accessible way, making it ideal for children who are ready to start formal STEM learning and activities that challenge their intellectual curiosity.

**Q: What specific skills will my child gain?**
In addition to general knowledge of engineering, your child will develop creativity, problem-solving skills, critical thinking ability, and an early interest in science (STEM) fields.

**Q: Does the book require extra materials?**
